يَحْمُومٌ : see أَحَمُّ, in two places. ―
-b2- Also Smoke: (S, M, K:) or black smoke: (Bd in lvi. 42:) or intensely black smoke. (Jel ibid. and TA.) ―
-b3- A black mountain: (K:) or a certain black mountain in Hell. (TA.) ―
-b4- The canopy, or awning, that is extended over the people of Hell: so, as some say, in the Kur lvi. 42. (TA.) ―
-b5- A certain bird: (K:) so called because of the blackness of its wings. (TA.) ―
-b6- نَبْتٌ يَحْمُومٌ A plant, or herbage, green, full of moisture, and black. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
